tess_cs: Quick flag  Zenith onboarding blocked by repeated 429s during init. They see flurry of 200s then a concentrated 30s window of 429s immediately after ephemeral token rotate. Using browser-sdk v0.9.2 behind a corporate proxy. Any quick triage pointers? :eyes:

omar_sdk: Classic token-rotation stampede. How many parallel inits are they doing? If they fan out to multiple routes on load it'll hit the per-key windows.

tess_cs: Customer says they spawn 10 workers on login to warm embeddings + chat. Log excerpt they pasted:
```
2026-05-11T08:07:12Z INFO token_refresh ok user=zenith id=zt-99 ttl=60s
2026-05-11T08:07:13Z WARN http resp status=429 x-request-id=zx-101 attempts=4
2026-05-11T08:07:14Z WARN http resp status=429 x-request-id=zx-102 attempts=3
```
They also mentioned their proxy sometimes replays requests when keepalive resets.

vikram_eng: Two fast repros to ask them to run: 1) set `maxParallelInit: 3` in the SDK; 2) add randomized 150-450ms jitter to token refresh. If 429s fall away we push client-side splay guidance.

omar_sdk: If they can't ship client changes quickly, offer an ops mitigation: temporarily increase ephemeral TTL from 60->120s for their API key for 24-48h and enable soft-smoothing on bursts. Need CS+ops sign-off. Pros: fewer rotations; cons: longer-lived tokens (call out security tradeoff).

tess_cs: I drafted a tiny playbook and asked Zenith for permission to apply the TTL bump + smoothing window. Also asked them to capture `x-request-id` values and `x-ratewindow` header during the incident for correlation.

ovps-bot: (typo) ops-bot: Note added to case ZEN-712 by tess_cs  "probable preflight stampede at token rotate; requested client splay; offered TTL bump + smoothing if needed"

ovarvikram_eng: For ops diag include these commands: 
```
grep "x-request-id" /var/log/redwood/ingress.log | grep <api_key>
awk '/x-ratewindow/ {print}' /var/log/redwood/ingress.log | grep <api_key>
```
Confirm whether the burst maps to a single IP (proxy) or multiple IPs (multi-tab/workers). If single IP and proxy replay suspected, loop infra to check header rewrites and retry behavior.

tess_cs: Zenith accepted staged repro in staging and gave ops permission to do TTL bump if repro fails. Scheduled window 03:30 UTC tomorrow. Ill update the ticket ZEN-712 with playbook and dashboard link. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
